description: Two storey side extension; Alterations and extension to roof to raise ridge height and create habitable floor and side dormers; Roof lights in front, side and rear roof slopes (Demolition of side extension)
decision_conditions: The proposed development would be sited within close proximity to a number of trees that are protected by virtue of them being sited within a conservation area and due to the lack of an appropriate tree survey and arboricultural impact assessment plan in accordance with best practice, the local planning authority is unable to fully assess the impacts of the proposed development on the retained trees and in the absence of such details the&nbsp; proposal would therefore be contrary to Policy G14 of Harrow Local Plan 2021-2041 and policy G7 of the London Plan 2021.

<p class="MsoNormal">The proposed two storey side extension, alteration to
fenestrations and roof alterations, by reason of its scale, inappropriate roof
form, misaligned fenestrations would result&nbsp; in an unduly, obtrusive and
incongruous addition to the original dwellinghouse which would fail to respect
the character and proportions of the dwellinghouse, cause loss of
openness &nbsp;and detrimentally impact the &nbsp;visual amenity of the
locality and Conservation Area and harm setting of the nearby locally listed
building. There is not clear and convincing justification for the
heritage harm that would result, nor public benefits to outweigh them. There
is also insufficient detailed information to fully assess. Therefore the
proposal would be contrary to the high quality design aspiration of the
National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 (D.1 and D.11) and HC1 of
The London Plan (2021), Policies GR1 and HE1 of the Harrow Local Plan
(2021-2041)and the relevant provisions of the Harrow Supplementary Planning
Document Residential Design Guide (2010).<o:p></o:p></p>
